_comment: Source of truth for the tier-ladder intermediates. tools/gen_items.py turns each entry
into a texture, a model and a KubeJS registration.
'botania:mana_powder.png'     any mod's item texture, found across mods/*.jar
hue is degrees 0-360 (absolute, not a rotation); sat/val are multipliers; sat_floor lifts
near-white bases so they can actually take colour.
Ladder entries below Era III are generated by tools/gen_ladder.py from the 2n-3 curve.
Era III = 3 steps ... Era X = 17, ~80 steps and ~45 items in total.

items.name: Living Fibre
items.tooltip: A botanical thread drawn from Dreamwood and green and lime petals in the Petal Apothecary. Infuse it with 2,000 mana in a Mana Pool to make Charged Fibre.
items._recipe: Petal Apothecary: 2 green petal + 2 lime petal + dreamwood

items.name: Charged Fibre
items.tooltip: Living Fibre infused with mana. Bind it with the Runic Altar reagents to make Verdant Filament, the starting material for Gateweaving.

items.name: Verdant Filament

items.name: Sunbleached Floss

items.name: Traded Skein
